title: fxv upgrade command payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv upgrade` command's JSON output.

upgraded.description: Whether the binary was actually replaced. False means the running binary was already the latest release.

previous_version.description: The version that was running before this command executed.

latest_version.description: The newest available release version. When upgraded is false, this is normally equal to previous_version, but can be lower if the running binary is newer than the latest published release (e.g. a local/dev build).

critical.description: Whether latest_version was flagged as a security or data-integrity fix worth upgrading for promptly.

message.description: Free-text detail about the release, shown alongside a critical notice. Null when absent.
